The Great Mage

The Lizard Hermit says the Chosen One went to the Great Mage of Gipath before disappearing. The Chosen One used a tunnel, but a surface route now leads through the gorge in the eastern Distant Mountains.

Objectives

Go to the gorge

Get through the gorge

Enter the mage's home
